destinations.name: Walt Disney World
destinations.description:
Walt Disney World is a large theme park resort located in Florida.
            Visitors can experience rides, themed attractions, entertainment,
            restaurants, and character experiences.
destinations.bestTime:
Spring and fall can be good times to visit because temperatures
            may be more comfortable than during the summer.

destinations.name: Universal Orlando Resort
destinations.description:
Universal Orlando Resort is a theme park destination featuring
            rides, themed areas, entertainment, restaurants, and attractions
            based on popular movies and characters.
activities: Experience roller coasters and thrill rides.
Explore themed areas throughout the resort.
destinations.bestTime:
Spring and fall can offer comfortable weather for exploring
            the parks.

destinations.name: Dollywood
destinations.description:
Dollywood is a theme park featuring roller coasters, family
            attractions, live entertainment, food, and seasonal events.
activities: Ride roller coasters and other attractions.
destinations.bestTime:
Spring and fall are popular times to visit because of the
            comfortable weather and seasonal scenery.

destinations.name: Six Flags Over Texas
destinations.description:
Six Flags Over Texas is a theme park featuring roller coasters,
            thrill rides, family attractions, entertainment, and food.
destinations.bestTime:
Spring and fall can provide more comfortable temperatures
            for spending the day outdoors.

destinations.name: Universal Volcano Bay
destinations.description:
Universal Volcano Bay is a tropical-themed water park featuring
            water slides, pools, rivers, and other water attractions.
activities: Enjoy the pools and water attractions.
destinations.bestTime:
Late spring and summer are popular times for enjoying the
            water attractions and warm weather.

destinations.name: Aquatica Orlando
destinations.description:
Aquatica Orlando is a water park featuring water slides,
            pools, rivers, and attractions for visitors of different ages.
destinations.bestTime:
Spring and summer are popular times to enjoy the park's
            outdoor water attractions.

destinations.name: Schlitterbahn New Braunfels
destinations.description:
Schlitterbahn New Braunfels is a water park featuring slides,
            pools, rivers, and family-friendly water attractions.
destinations.bestTime:
Summer is a popular time to visit because of the warm Texas
            weather.

destinations.name: Noah's Ark Waterpark
destinations.description:
Noah's Ark Waterpark is an outdoor water park featuring
            water slides, pools, and attractions for families and
            thrill seekers.
destinations.bestTime:
Summer is a great time to visit because the outdoor
            attractions are open for the season.

name: Wildlife Parks
description: Learn about animals and outdoor habitats.

destinations.name: San Diego Zoo Safari Park
destinations.description:
San Diego Zoo Safari Park is a wildlife destination where
            visitors can see animals and explore large outdoor habitats.
destinations.bestTime:
Spring and fall can provide comfortable weather for
            exploring the outdoor areas.

destinations.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom
destinations.description:
Disney's Animal Kingdom combines wildlife experiences with
            rides, themed attractions, entertainment, and animal exhibits.
activities: Explore the themed areas of the park.
destinations.bestTime:
Spring and fall can provide more comfortable temperatures
            for exploring the park.

destinations.name: Yellowstone Bear World
destinations.description:
Yellowstone Bear World is a wildlife attraction where visitors
            can observe bears and other North American wildlife.
activities: Learn more about North American animals.
destinations.bestTime:
Late spring and summer provide warmer weather for visiting
            the outdoor attraction.

destinations.name: Lion Country Safari
destinations.description:
Lion Country Safari is a wildlife park where visitors can
            observe a variety of animals and explore wildlife attractions.
destinations.bestTime:
Fall through spring can provide comfortable temperatures
            for spending time outdoors in Florida.

name: National Parks
description: Discover trails, landscapes, and natural wonders.

destinations.name: Yellowstone National Park
destinations.description:
Yellowstone National Park is known for its wildlife,
            geothermal features, mountains, forests, lakes, and
            outdoor recreation.
activities: See geysers and other geothermal features.
Explore hiking trails and scenic areas.
destinations.bestTime:
Late spring through early fall is popular because more
            roads and visitor areas are accessible.

destinations.name: Yosemite National Park
destinations.description:
Yosemite National Park is known for its mountains,
            waterfalls, valleys, forests, hiking trails, and scenic views.
destinations.bestTime:
Spring is popular for waterfalls, while summer provides
            access to many areas of the park.

destinations.name: Grand Canyon National Park
destinations.description:
Grand Canyon National Park is known for its enormous canyon,
            scenic overlooks, hiking trails, and colorful rock formations.
destinations.bestTime:
Spring and fall are popular because temperatures are
            generally more comfortable for outdoor activities.

destinations.name: Great Smoky Mountains National Park
destinations.description:
Great Smoky Mountains National Park is known for its
            mountains, forests, wildlife, hiking trails, and scenic views.
destinations.bestTime:
Spring and fall are popular because visitors can experience
            wildflowers or colorful fall foliage.
